issue_description: cron-cowork-team.md prompt block used 'Launch subagent (subagent_type=cowork-team)' which would fail because cowork-team is not an agent (no .claude/agents/cowork-team.md); it is a CronCreate command that should invoke the dispatcher flow directly
fix_applied: Changed prompt from 'Launch subagent (subagent_type=cowork-team). Read and execute .claude/commands/cowork-team.md' to 'Read and execute .claude/flows/cowork-team/main.md' per dev-team precedent
commit_message: fix(sprint-1951): cowork-team cron prompt should run flow not spawn nonexistent subagent
